transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our recovery huddle started regarding the P-4 palletizer stoppage. As we all know, P-4 went down during the morning shift, and we have the manual palletizing station in the finished-goods warehouse available as a temporary alternative. We've got an urgent outbound order at the end of the week, so we need to move quickly and carefully. Before I make a binding decision on the recovery method and controls, I need to hear from each functional owner on three things: maintenance findings, shipment staging requirements, and energy-isolation controls. Please share your current findings even if your formal reports are still being processed. Let's start with maintenance -- what do we know about why P-4 stopped and what's needed to get it back online?
